module: Flowgraph node 'Record Camera' (repeat_f_duration category). Records a camera path with keyframes: the first 'snap' impulse starts the recording, each following 'snap' adds a key (pos, rot, os.clock time). The 'stop' impulse ends it and creates in MissionGroup a SimPath object with a Marker per key (position, rotation, timeToNext). Output 'filename': generated name (prefix + os.time()).
notes: The first snap starts the recording and also adds the first key (both tests are evaluated in the same frame).
The marker names are 'maker_N' (typo for marker).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

_executionStarted.desc: Resets to the inactive state, empties the path and stores the start time.

finishUp.desc: Creates the SimPath and the Markers (maker_N) from the recorded path, sets timeToNext and writes filename.

work.desc: State inactive: snap starts the recording. State started: snap adds a key; stop goes to 'finished' and calls finishUp.

drawMiddle.desc: Displays the state and the number of keys.
